newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end firm, FTSE 100 sets new closing high.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end firm, FTSE 100 sets new closing high.

text.p: Leading British shares ended higher on Tuesday -- with the FTSE 100 closing at a new record -- fuelled by strong futures and gilt market, traders said.

The perception that cash-rich institutional funds are poised to funnel money back into UK equity market in the last quarter of the year renewed hopes that the FTSE 100 will decisively charge through the 4,000 level this week.

The benchmark FTSE 100 added 38.5 points to finish at a new closing high at 3,992.2, the day's best level and only 1.9 points from the record intraday peak set on September 20. December FTSE futures closed 47 points higher at 4,034.
